# Smart Court — Database Schema (SQL Server DDL)

> **Version:** 2.0 (Enhanced) | **Database:** SQL Server 2022
> **Source:** `schema.md` + `schema_architectural_review.md`
> **Collation:** `Arabic_CI_AS` (Arabic case-insensitive)

---

## Module 1 — Identity & User Management

```sql
-- =============================================
-- ASP.NET Identity tables are auto-generated by
-- EF Core Identity. We extend AspNetUsers below.
-- The Identity framework creates:
--   AspNetUsers, AspNetRoles, AspNetUserRoles,
--   AspNetUserClaims, AspNetUserLogins, AspNetUserTokens,
--   AspNetRoleClaims
-- =============================================

-- Extended columns added to AspNetUsers via ApplicationUser entity
-- (EF Core adds these columns to the Identity-generated table)
/*
  Additional columns on AspNetUsers:
    FirstName NVARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    LastName NVARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    ProfilePictureFileId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NULL,
    IsActive BIT NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
    IsDeleted BIT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    DeletedAt DATETIME2 NULL,
    LastLoginAt DATETIME2 NULL,
    CreatedAt DATETIME2 NOT NULL DEFAULT GETUTCDATE(),
    UpdatedAt DATETIME2 NOT NULL DEFAULT GETUTCDATE()
*/

-- =============================================
-- FILE STORAGE
-- =============================================
CREATE TABLE StoredFile (
    Id                  UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL DEFAULT NEWSEQUENTIALID(),
    OriginalFileName    NVARCHAR(500)    NOT NULL,
    StoredFileName      NVARCHAR(500)    NOT NULL,
    ContentType         VARCHAR(100)     NOT NULL,
    Extension           VARCHAR(20)      NOT NULL,
    FileSize            BIGINT           NOT NULL,
    StoragePath         NVARCHAR(MAX)    NOT NULL,
    StorageProvider     VARCHAR(50)      NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Local',  -- Local, S3, AzureBlob
    Checksum            VARCHAR(128)     NULL,                       -- SHA-256
    SensitivityLevel    INT              NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,         -- 0=Public, 1=Internal, 2=Confidential, 3=Restricted
    UploadedByUserId    UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL,
    IsDeleted           BIT              NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    DeletedAt           DATETIME2        NULL,
    CreatedAt           DATETIME2        NOT NULL DEFAULT GETUTCDATE(),

    CONSTRAINT PK_StoredFile PRIMARY KEY (Id),
    CONSTRAINT FK_StoredFile_User FOREIGN KEY (UploadedByUserId) REFERENCES AspNetUsers(Id),
    CONSTRAINT CK_StoredFile_SensitivityLevel CHECK (SensitivityLevel IN (0, 1, 2, 3))
);

CREATE INDEX IX_StoredFile_UploadedByUserId ON StoredFile(UploadedByUserId);

-- =============================================
-- CLIENT PROFILE
-- =============================================
CREATE TABLE ClientProfile (
    UserId                         UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL,
    DateOfBirth                    DATETIME2        NULL,
    NationalIdFrontFileId          UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NULL,
    NationalIdBackFileId           UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NULL,
    NationalIdVerificationStatus   INT              NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    NationalIdReviewedByUserId     UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NULL,
    NationalIdVerifiedAt           DATETIME2        NULL,
    CreatedAt                      DATETIME2        NOT NULL DEFAULT GETUTCDATE(),
    UpdatedAt                      DATETIME2        NOT NULL DEFAULT GETUTCDATE(),

    CONSTRAINT PK_ClientProfile PRIMARY KEY (UserId),
    CONSTRAINT FK_ClientProfile_User FOREIGN KEY (UserId) REFERENCES AspNetUsers(Id),
    CONSTRAINT FK_ClientProfile_NatIdFront FOREIGN KEY (NationalIdFrontFileId) REFERENCES StoredFile(Id),
    CONSTRAINT FK_ClientProfile_NatIdBack FOREIGN KEY (NationalIdBackFileId) REFERENCES StoredFile(Id),
    CONSTRAINT FK_ClientProfile_NatIdReviewer FOREIGN KEY (NationalIdReviewedByUserId) REFERENCES AspNetUsers(Id),
    CONSTRAINT CK_ClientProfile_NatIdStatus CHECK (NationalIdVerificationStatus IN (0, 1, 2, 3))
);

-- =============================================
-- LAWYER PROFILE
-- =============================================
CREATE TABLE LawyerProfile (
    UserId                         UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL,
    OfficeAddress                  NVARCHAR(500)    NULL,
    Bio                            NVARCHAR(MAX)    NULL,
    YearsOfExperience              INT              NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    IsAvailable                    BIT              NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    -- National ID Verification
    NationalIdFrontFileId          UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NULL,
    NationalIdBackFileId           UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NULL,
    NationalIdVerificationStatus   INT              NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    NationalIdReviewedByUserId     UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NULL,
    NationalIdVerifiedAt           DATETIME2        NULL,
    -- Bar Card Verification
    BarCardFrontFileId             UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NULL,
    BarCardBackFileId              UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NULL,
    BarCardVerificationStatus      INT              NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    BarCardReviewedByUserId        UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NULL,
    BarCardVerifiedAt              DATETIME2        NULL,
    -- Denormalized (updated on review creation)
    AverageRating                  DECIMAL(3,2)     NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.00,
    TotalReviews                   INT              NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    -- Timestamps
    CreatedAt                      DATETIME2        NOT NULL DEFAULT GETUTCDATE(),
    UpdatedAt                      DATETIME2        NOT NULL DEFAULT GETUTCDATE(),

    CONSTRAINT PK_LawyerProfile PRIMARY KEY (UserId),
    CONSTRAINT FK_LawyerProfile_User FOREIGN KEY (UserId) REFERENCES AspNetUsers(Id),
    CONSTRAINT FK_LawyerProfile_NatIdFront FOREIGN KEY (NationalIdFrontFileId) REFERENCES StoredFile(Id),
    CONSTRAINT FK_LawyerProfile_NatIdBack FOREIGN KEY (NationalIdBackFileId) REFERENCES StoredFile(Id),
    CONSTRAINT FK_LawyerProfile_NatIdReviewer FOREIGN KEY (NationalIdReviewedByUserId) REFERENCES AspNetUsers(Id),
    CONSTRAINT FK_LawyerProfile_BarFront FOREIGN KEY (BarCardFrontFileId) REFERENCES StoredFile(Id),
    CONSTRAINT FK_LawyerProfile_BarBack FOREIGN KEY (BarCardBackFileId) REFERENCES StoredFile(Id),
    CONSTRAINT FK_LawyerProfile_BarReviewer FOREIGN KEY (BarCardReviewedByUserId) REFERENCES AspNetUsers(Id),
    CONSTRAINT CK_LawyerProfile_NatIdStatus CHECK (NationalIdVerificationStatus IN (0, 1, 2, 3)),
    CONSTRAINT CK_LawyerProfile_BarStatus CHECK (BarCardVerificationStatus IN (0, 1, 2, 3)),
    CONSTRAINT CK_LawyerProfile_Rating CHECK (AverageRating >= 0.00 AND AverageRating <= 5.00),
    CONSTRAINT CK_LawyerProfile_Experience CHECK (YearsOfExperience >= 0 AND YearsOfExperience <= 60)
);

-- =============================================
-- LEGAL CATEGORIES
-- =============================================
CREATE TABLE LegalCategory (
    Id                  UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL DEFAULT NEWSEQUENTIALID(),
    Name                NVARCHAR(200)    NOT NULL,
    Description         NVARCHAR(MAX)    NULL,
    CreatedAt           DATETIME2        NOT NULL DEFAULT GETUTCDATE(),
    UpdatedAt           DATETIME2        NOT NULL DEFAULT GETUTCDATE(),

    CONSTRAINT PK_LegalCategory PRIMARY KEY (Id)
);

-- =============================================
-- LAWYER SPECIALIZATIONS (Junction Table)
-- =============================================
CREATE TABLE LawyerSpecialization (
    LawyerUserId    UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL,
    LegalCategoryId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL,

    CONSTRAINT PK_LawyerSpecialization PRIMARY KEY (LawyerUserId, LegalCategoryId),
    CONSTRAINT FK_LawyerSpec_Lawyer FOREIGN KEY (LawyerUserId) REFERENCES LawyerProfile(UserId) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    CONSTRAINT FK_LawyerSpec_Category FOREIGN KEY (LegalCategoryId) REFERENCES LegalCategory(Id) ON DELETE CASCADE
);
```

---

## Module 2 — Legal Cases & AI

```sql
-- =============================================
-- LEGAL CASE
-- =============================================
CREATE TABLE LegalCase (
    Id                      UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL DEFAULT NEWSEQUENTIALID(),
    ClientUserId            UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL,
    Title                   NVARCHAR(200)    NOT NULL,
    Description             NVARCHAR(MAX)    NOT NULL,
    CaseLocation            NVARCHAR(300)    NULL,
    Status                  INT              NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    AssignedLawyerUserId    UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NULL,        -- Denormalized: set on proposal accept
    FinalSubmittedAt        DATETIME2        NULL,
    IsDeleted               BIT              NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    DeletedAt               DATETIME2        NULL,
    CreatedAt               DATETIME2        NOT NULL DEFAULT GETUTCDATE(),
    UpdatedAt               DATETIME2        NOT NULL DEFAULT GETUTCDATE(),

    CONSTRAINT PK_LegalCase PRIMARY KEY (Id),
    CONSTRAINT FK_LegalCase_Client FOREIGN KEY (ClientUserId) REFERENCES ClientProfile(UserId),
    CONSTRAINT FK_LegalCase_AssignedLawyer FOREIGN KEY (AssignedLawyerUserId) REFERENCES LawyerProfile(UserId),
    CONSTRAINT CK_LegalCase_Status CHECK (Status IN (0, 1, 2, 3, 4))
    -- 0=Draft, 1=Submitted, 2=Analyzed, 3=Finalized, 4=Matched
);

CREATE INDEX IX_LegalCase_ClientStatus ON LegalCase(ClientUserId, Status);

-- =============================================
-- AI ANALYSIS
-- =============================================
CREATE TABLE AIAnalysis (
    Id                  UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL DEFAULT NEWSEQUENTIALID(),
    LegalCaseId         UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL,
    AnalysisNumber      INT              NOT NULL,
    LegalCategoryId     UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NULL,
    StrengthPoints      NVARCHAR(MAX)    NOT NULL,
    WeakPoints          NVARCHAR(MAX)    NOT NULL,
    MissingInformation  NVARCHAR(MAX)    NOT NULL,
    Recommendations     NVARCHAR(MAX)    NOT NULL,
    OverallAssessment   NVARCHAR(MAX)    NOT NULL,
    ConfidenceScore     DECIMAL(5,4)     NOT NULL,
    RawResponse         NVARCHAR(MAX)    NULL,    -- Full JSON backup of AI response
    ModelName           VARCHAR(100)     NOT NULL,
    PromptTokens        INT              NOT NULL,
    CompletionTokens    INT              NOT NULL,
    TotalTokens         INT              NOT NULL,
    CreatedAt           DATETIME2        NOT NULL DEFAULT GETUTCDATE(),

    CONSTRAINT PK_AIAnalysis PRIMARY KEY (Id),
    CONSTRAINT FK_AIAnalysis_Case FOREIGN KEY (LegalCaseId) REFERENCES LegalCase(Id),
    CONSTRAINT FK_AIAnalysis_Category FOREIGN KEY (LegalCategoryId) REFERENCES LegalCategory(Id),
    CONSTRAINT CK_AIAnalysis_Confidence CHECK (ConfidenceScore >= 0.0 AND ConfidenceScore <= 1.0)
);

CREATE INDEX IX_AIAnalysis_CaseId ON AIAnalysis(LegalCaseId, AnalysisNumber DESC);

-- =============================================
-- LAWYER MATCH CACHE
-- =============================================
CREATE TABLE LawyerMatch (
    Id              UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL DEFAULT NEWSEQUENTIALID(),
    LegalCaseId     UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL,
    LawyerUserId    UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL,
    AIAnalysisId    UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NULL,        -- Which analysis produced this match
    MatchScore      DECIMAL(5,2)     NOT NULL,
    MatchReason     NVARCHAR(MAX)    NOT NULL,
    Rank            INT              NOT NULL,
    CreatedAt       DATETIME2        NOT NULL DEFAULT GETUTCDATE(),

    CONSTRAINT PK_LawyerMatch PRIMARY KEY (Id),
    CONSTRAINT FK_LawyerMatch_Case FOREIGN KEY (LegalCaseId) REFERENCES LegalCase(Id),
    CONSTRAINT FK_LawyerMatch_Lawyer FOREIGN KEY (LawyerUserId) REFERENCES LawyerProfile(UserId),
    CONSTRAINT FK_LawyerMatch_Analysis FOREIGN KEY (AIAnalysisId) REFERENCES AIAnalysis(Id),
    CONSTRAINT UQ_LawyerMatch_CaseLawyer UNIQUE (LegalCaseId, LawyerUserId)
);

CREATE INDEX IX_LawyerMatch_CaseRank ON LawyerMatch(LegalCaseId, Rank);

-- =============================================
-- CASE ATTACHMENTS
-- =============================================
CREATE TABLE CaseAttachment (
    Id                  UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL DEFAULT NEWSEQUENTIALID(),
    LegalCaseId         UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL,
    StoredFileId        UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL,
    UploadedByUserId    UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL,
    CreatedAt           DATETIME2        NOT NULL DEFAULT GETUTCDATE(),

    CONSTRAINT PK_CaseAttachment PRIMARY KEY (Id),
    CONSTRAINT FK_CaseAttachment_Case FOREIGN KEY (LegalCaseId) REFERENCES LegalCase(Id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    CONSTRAINT FK_CaseAttachment_File FOREIGN KEY (StoredFileId) REFERENCES StoredFile(Id),
    CONSTRAINT FK_CaseAttachment_User FOREIGN KEY (UploadedByUserId) REFERENCES AspNetUsers(Id)
);
```

---

## Module 3 — Proposals & Communication

```sql
-- =============================================
-- PROPOSALS
-- =============================================
CREATE TABLE Proposal (
    Id              UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL DEFAULT NEWSEQUENTIALID(),
    LegalCaseId     UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL,
    ClientUserId    UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL,
    LawyerUserId    UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL,
    Status          INT              NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    RejectionReason NVARCHAR(MAX)    NULL,
    CreatedAt       DATETIME2        NOT NULL DEFAULT GETUTCDATE(),
    UpdatedAt       DATETIME2        NOT NULL DEFAULT GETUTCDATE(),

    CONSTRAINT PK_Proposal PRIMARY KEY (Id),
    CONSTRAINT FK_Proposal_Case FOREIGN KEY (LegalCaseId) REFERENCES LegalCase(Id),
    CONSTRAINT FK_Proposal_Client FOREIGN KEY (ClientUserId) REFERENCES ClientProfile(UserId),
    CONSTRAINT FK_Proposal_Lawyer FOREIGN KEY (LawyerUserId) REFERENCES LawyerProfile(UserId),
    CONSTRAINT CK_Proposal_Status CHECK (Status IN (0, 1, 2))
    -- 0=Pending, 1=Accepted, 2=Rejected
);

CREATE INDEX IX_Proposal_LawyerStatus ON Proposal(LawyerUserId, Status);
CREATE INDEX IX_Proposal_CaseStatus ON Proposal(LegalCaseId, Status);

-- =============================================
-- CONVERSATIONS
-- =============================================
CREATE TABLE Conversation (
    Id                          UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL DEFAULT NEWSEQUENTIALID(),
    ProposalId                  UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL,
    IsClosed                    BIT              NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    ClosedAt                    DATETIME2        NULL,
    -- Denormalized for inbox performance
    LastMessageAt               DATETIME2        NULL,
    LastMessagePreview          NVARCHAR(200)    NULL,
    LastMessageSenderUserId     UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NULL,
    CreatedAt                   DATETIME2        NOT NULL DEFAULT GETUTCDATE(),
    UpdatedAt                   DATETIME2        NOT NULL DEFAULT GETUTCDATE(),

    CONSTRAINT PK_Conversation PRIMARY KEY (Id),
    CONSTRAINT FK_Conversation_Proposal FOREIGN KEY (ProposalId) REFERENCES Proposal(Id),
    CONSTRAINT UQ_Conversation_Proposal UNIQUE (ProposalId),
    CONSTRAINT FK_Conversation_LastSender FOREIGN KEY (LastMessageSenderUserId) REFERENCES AspNetUsers(Id)
);

-- =============================================
-- CONVERSATION PARTICIPANTS
-- =============================================
CREATE TABLE ConversationParticipant (
    ConversationId  UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL,
    UserId          UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL,
    JoinedAt        DATETIME2        NOT NULL DEFAULT GETUTCDATE(),
    LeftAt          DATETIME2        NULL,

    CONSTRAINT PK_ConversationParticipant PRIMARY KEY (ConversationId, UserId),
    CONSTRAINT FK_ConvPart_Conversation FOREIGN KEY (ConversationId) REFERENCES Conversation(Id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    CONSTRAINT FK_ConvPart_User FOREIGN KEY (UserId) REFERENCES AspNetUsers(Id)
);

-- =============================================
-- MESSAGES
-- =============================================
CREATE TABLE Message (
    Id              UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL DEFAULT NEWSEQUENTIALID(),
    ConversationId  UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL,
    SenderUserId    UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL,
    MessageType     INT              NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    Content         NVARCHAR(MAX)    NULL,
    IsEdited        BIT              NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    EditedAt        DATETIME2        NULL,
    IsDeleted       BIT              NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    DeletedAt       DATETIME2        NULL,
    CreatedAt       DATETIME2        NOT NULL DEFAULT GETUTCDATE(),

    CONSTRAINT PK_Message PRIMARY KEY (Id),
    CONSTRAINT FK_Message_Conversation FOREIGN KEY (ConversationId) REFERENCES Conversation(Id),
    CONSTRAINT FK_Message_Sender FOREIGN KEY (SenderUserId) REFERENCES AspNetUsers(Id),
    CONSTRAINT CK_Message_Type CHECK (MessageType IN (0, 1, 2, 3, 4))
    -- 0=Text, 1=File, 2=Voice, 3=System, 4=ProposalMessage
);

CREATE INDEX IX_Message_ConversationCreatedAt ON Message(ConversationId, CreatedAt DESC);

-- =============================================
-- MESSAGE ATTACHMENTS
-- =============================================
CREATE TABLE MessageAttachment (
    Id              UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL DEFAULT NEWSEQUENTIALID(),
    MessageId       UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL,
    StoredFileId    UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL,
    CreatedAt       DATETIME2        NOT NULL DEFAULT GETUTCDATE(),

    CONSTRAINT PK_MessageAttachment PRIMARY KEY (Id),
    CONSTRAINT FK_MsgAttach_Message FOREIGN KEY (MessageId) REFERENCES Message(Id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    CONSTRAINT FK_MsgAttach_File FOREIGN KEY (StoredFileId) REFERENCES StoredFile(Id)
);
```

---

## Module 4 — Contracts & Payments

```sql
-- =============================================
-- CONTRACT
-- =============================================
CREATE TABLE Contract (
    Id                  UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL DEFAULT NEWSEQUENTIALID(),
    ProposalId          UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL,
    Status              INT              NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    TotalAmount         DECIMAL(18,2)    NOT NULL,
    Currency            VARCHAR(3)       NOT NULL DEFAULT 'EGP',
    TermsAndConditions  NVARCHAR(MAX)    NOT NULL,
    SignedByClientAt    DATETIME2        NULL,
    SignedByLawyerAt    DATETIME2        NULL,
    StartedAt           DATETIME2        NULL,
    CompletedAt         DATETIME2        NULL,
    CancelledAt         DATETIME2        NULL,
    CancelledByUserId   UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NULL,
    CancellationReason  NVARCHAR(MAX)    NULL,
    IsDeleted           BIT              NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    CreatedAt           DATETIME2        NOT NULL DEFAULT GETUTCDATE(),
    UpdatedAt           DATETIME2        NOT NULL DEFAULT GETUTCDATE(),

    CONSTRAINT PK_Contract PRIMARY KEY (Id),
    CONSTRAINT FK_Contract_Proposal FOREIGN KEY (ProposalId) REFERENCES Proposal(Id),
    CONSTRAINT UQ_Contract_Proposal UNIQUE (ProposalId),
    CONSTRAINT FK_Contract_CancelledBy FOREIGN KEY (CancelledByUserId) REFERENCES AspNetUsers(Id),
    CONSTRAINT CK_Contract_Status CHECK (Status IN (0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5)),
    -- 0=Draft, 1=PendingSignature, 2=Active, 3=Completed, 4=Cancelled, 5=Disputed
    CONSTRAINT CK_Contract_Amount CHECK (TotalAmount > 0),
    CONSTRAINT CK_Contract_Currency CHECK (Currency = 'EGP')
);

CREATE INDEX IX_Contract_Status ON Contract(Status);

-- =============================================
-- MILESTONES
-- =============================================
CREATE TABLE Milestone (
    Id              UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL DEFAULT NEWSEQUENTIALID(),
    ContractId      UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL,
    Title           NVARCHAR(200)    NOT NULL,
    Description     NVARCHAR(MAX)    NULL,
    OrderNumber     INT              NOT NULL,
    Amount          DECIMAL(18,2)    NOT NULL,
    DueDate         DATETIME2        NULL,
    Status          INT              NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    SubmittedAt     DATETIME2        NULL,
    ApprovedAt      DATETIME2        NULL,
    RejectedAt      DATETIME2        NULL,
    RejectionReason NVARCHAR(MAX)    NULL,
    CreatedAt       DATETIME2        NOT NULL DEFAULT GETUTCDATE(),
    UpdatedAt       DATETIME2        NOT NULL DEFAULT GETUTCDATE(),

    CONSTRAINT PK_Milestone PRIMARY KEY (Id),
    CONSTRAINT FK_Milestone_Contract FOREIGN KEY (ContractId) REFERENCES Contract(Id),
    CONSTRAINT CK_Milestone_Status CHECK (Status IN (0, 1, 2, 3, 4)),
    -- 0=Pending, 1=InProgress, 2=Submitted, 3=Approved, 4=Rejected
    CONSTRAINT CK_Milestone_Amount CHECK (Amount > 0)
);

-- =============================================
-- SCHEDULED PAYMENTS
-- =============================================
CREATE TABLE ScheduledPayment (
    Id                  UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL DEFAULT NEWSEQUENTIALID(),
    ContractId          UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL,
    Title               NVARCHAR(200)    NOT NULL,
    Amount              DECIMAL(18,2)    NOT NULL,
    StartDate           DATETIME2        NOT NULL,
    EndDate             DATETIME2        NULL,
    IntervalInDays      INT              NOT NULL,
    NextExecutionDate   DATETIME2        NOT NULL,
    IsActive            BIT              NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
    CreatedAt           DATETIME2        NOT NULL DEFAULT GETUTCDATE(),
    UpdatedAt           DATETIME2        NOT NULL DEFAULT GETUTCDATE(),

    CONSTRAINT PK_ScheduledPayment PRIMARY KEY (Id),
    CONSTRAINT FK_ScheduledPay_Contract FOREIGN KEY (ContractId) REFERENCES Contract(Id),
    CONSTRAINT CK_ScheduledPay_Amount CHECK (Amount > 0),
    CONSTRAINT CK_ScheduledPay_Interval CHECK (IntervalInDays > 0)
);

CREATE INDEX IX_ScheduledPayment_NextExec ON ScheduledPayment(NextExecutionDate) WHERE IsActive = 1;

-- =============================================
-- ESCROW ACCOUNT (NEW — from review)
-- =============================================
CREATE TABLE EscrowAccount (
    Id                      UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL DEFAULT NEWSEQUENTIALID(),
    ContractId              UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL,
    TotalDeposited          DECIMAL(18,2)    NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    TotalReleased           DECIMAL(18,2)    NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    TotalRefunded           DECIMAL(18,2)    NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    PlatformFeeCollected    DECIMAL(18,2)    NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    CurrentBalance          AS (TotalDeposited - TotalReleased - TotalRefunded - PlatformFeeCollected) PERSISTED,
    Currency                VARCHAR(3)       NOT NULL DEFAULT 'EGP',
    Status                  INT              NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    CreatedAt               DATETIME2        NOT NULL DEFAULT GETUTCDATE(),
    UpdatedAt               DATETIME2        NOT NULL DEFAULT GETUTCDATE(),

    CONSTRAINT PK_EscrowAccount PRIMARY KEY (Id),
    CONSTRAINT FK_EscrowAccount_Contract FOREIGN KEY (ContractId) REFERENCES Contract(Id),
    CONSTRAINT UQ_EscrowAccount_Contract UNIQUE (ContractId),
    CONSTRAINT CK_EscrowAccount_Status CHECK (Status IN (0, 1, 2, 3))
    -- 0=Active, 1=Settled, 2=Disputed, 3=Frozen
);

-- =============================================
-- ESCROW TRANSACTION (NEW — immutable ledger)
-- =============================================
CREATE TABLE EscrowTransaction (
    Id                      UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL DEFAULT NEWSEQUENTIALID(),
    EscrowAccountId         UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL,
    TransactionType         INT              NOT NULL,
    Amount                  DECIMAL(18,2)    NOT NULL,
    RunningBalance          DECIMAL(18,2)    NOT NULL,
    ReferenceEntityType     VARCHAR(50)      NULL,
    ReferenceEntityId       UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NULL,
    PaymentTransactionId    UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NULL,
    Description             NVARCHAR(MAX)    NULL,
    CreatedByUserId         UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NULL,
    CreatedAt               DATETIME2        NOT NULL DEFAULT GETUTCDATE(),

    CONSTRAINT PK_EscrowTransaction PRIMARY KEY (Id),
    CONSTRAINT FK_EscrowTxn_Account FOREIGN KEY (EscrowAccountId) REFERENCES EscrowAccount(Id),
    CONSTRAINT FK_EscrowTxn_User FOREIGN KEY (CreatedByUserId) REFERENCES AspNetUsers(Id),
    CONSTRAINT CK_EscrowTxn_Type CHECK (TransactionType IN (0, 1, 2, 3, 4))
    -- 0=Deposit, 1=Release, 2=Refund, 3=PlatformFee, 4=Adjustment
);

CREATE INDEX IX_EscrowTxn_AccountCreatedAt ON EscrowTransaction(EscrowAccountId, CreatedAt);

-- =============================================
-- PAYMENT RELEASE
-- =============================================
CREATE TABLE PaymentRelease (
    Id                  UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL DEFAULT NEWSEQUENTIALID(),
    ContractId          UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL,
    MilestoneId         UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NULL,
    ScheduledPaymentId  UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NULL,
    ReleaseType         INT              NOT NULL,
    Amount              DECIMAL(18,2)    NOT NULL,
    Status              INT              NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    ReleasedAt          DATETIME2        NULL,
    CreatedAt           DATETIME2        NOT NULL DEFAULT GETUTCDATE(),

    CONSTRAINT PK_PaymentRelease PRIMARY KEY (Id),
    CONSTRAINT FK_PayRelease_Contract FOREIGN KEY (ContractId) REFERENCES Contract(Id),
    CONSTRAINT FK_PayRelease_Milestone FOREIGN KEY (MilestoneId) REFERENCES Milestone(Id),
    CONSTRAINT FK_PayRelease_Scheduled FOREIGN KEY (ScheduledPaymentId) REFERENCES ScheduledPayment(Id),
    CONSTRAINT CK_PayRelease_Type CHECK (ReleaseType IN (0, 1)),
    -- 0=Milestone, 1=ScheduledPayment
    CONSTRAINT CK_PayRelease_Status CHECK (Status IN (0, 1, 2)),
    -- 0=Pending, 1=Released, 2=Refunded
    CONSTRAINT CK_PayRelease_Amount CHECK (Amount > 0)
);

-- =============================================
-- PAYMENT TRANSACTION
-- =============================================
CREATE TABLE PaymentTransaction (
    Id                      UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL DEFAULT NEWSEQUENTIALID(),
    PaymentReleaseId        UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL,
    Gateway                 VARCHAR(50)      NOT NULL,
    GatewayTransactionId    VARCHAR(200)     NOT NULL,
    GatewayEventId          VARCHAR(200)     NULL,    -- Webhook idempotency key
    Amount                  DECIMAL(18,2)    NOT NULL,
    Currency                VARCHAR(3)       NOT NULL DEFAULT 'EGP',
    Status                  INT              NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    FailureReason           NVARCHAR(MAX)    NULL,
    RefundedAmount          DECIMAL(18,2)    NULL,
    RefundedAt              DATETIME2        NULL,
    ProcessedAt             DATETIME2        NULL,
    CreatedAt               DATETIME2        NOT NULL DEFAULT GETUTCDATE(),

    CONSTRAINT PK_PaymentTransaction PRIMARY KEY (Id),
    CONSTRAINT FK_PayTxn_Release FOREIGN KEY (PaymentReleaseId) REFERENCES PaymentRelease(Id),
    CONSTRAINT CK_PayTxn_Status CHECK (Status IN (0, 1, 2, 3)),
    -- 0=Pending, 1=Completed, 2=Failed, 3=Refunded
    CONSTRAINT CK_PayTxn_Amount CHECK (Amount > 0)
);

CREATE INDEX IX_PayTxn_GatewayTxnId ON PaymentTransaction(GatewayTransactionId);

-- =============================================
-- CONTRACT ATTACHMENTS
-- =============================================
CREATE TABLE ContractAttachment (
    Id              UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL DEFAULT NEWSEQUENTIALID(),
    ContractId      UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL,
    StoredFileId    UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL,
    CreatedAt       DATETIME2        NOT NULL DEFAULT GETUTCDATE(),

    CONSTRAINT PK_ContractAttachment PRIMARY KEY (Id),
    CONSTRAINT FK_ContractAttach_Contract FOREIGN KEY (ContractId) REFERENCES Contract(Id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    CONSTRAINT FK_ContractAttach_File FOREIGN KEY (StoredFileId) REFERENCES StoredFile(Id)
);
```

---

## Module 5 — Reviews, Disputes & Notifications

```sql
-- =============================================
-- REVIEWS
-- =============================================
CREATE TABLE Review (
    Id              UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL DEFAULT NEWSEQUENTIALID(),
    ContractId      UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL,
    ReviewerUserId  UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL,
    RevieweeUserId  UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL,
    Rating          INT              NOT NULL,
    Comment         NVARCHAR(MAX)    NOT NULL,
    IsVisible       BIT              NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
    HiddenReason    NVARCHAR(MAX)    NULL,
    CreatedAt       DATETIME2        NOT NULL DEFAULT GETUTCDATE(),
    UpdatedAt       DATETIME2        NOT NULL DEFAULT GETUTCDATE(),

    CONSTRAINT PK_Review PRIMARY KEY (Id),
    CONSTRAINT FK_Review_Contract FOREIGN KEY (ContractId) REFERENCES Contract(Id),
    CONSTRAINT FK_Review_Reviewer FOREIGN KEY (ReviewerUserId) REFERENCES AspNetUsers(Id),
    CONSTRAINT FK_Review_Reviewee FOREIGN KEY (RevieweeUserId) REFERENCES AspNetUsers(Id),
    CONSTRAINT UQ_Review_ContractReviewer UNIQUE (ContractId, ReviewerUserId),
    CONSTRAINT CK_Review_Rating CHECK (Rating >= 1 AND Rating <= 5)
);

CREATE INDEX IX_Review_RevieweeUserId ON Review(RevieweeUserId);

-- =============================================
-- DISPUTES
-- =============================================
CREATE TABLE Dispute (
    Id                          UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL DEFAULT NEWSEQUENTIALID(),
    ContractId                  UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL,
    RaisedByUserId              UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL,
    AssignedModeratorUserId     UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NULL,
    Title                       NVARCHAR(200)    NOT NULL,
    Description                 NVARCHAR(MAX)    NOT NULL,
    Status                      INT              NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    Priority                    INT              NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
    ResolutionSummary           NVARCHAR(MAX)    NULL,
    ResolvedAt                  DATETIME2        NULL,
    CreatedAt                   DATETIME2        NOT NULL DEFAULT GETUTCDATE(),
    UpdatedAt                   DATETIME2        NOT NULL DEFAULT GETUTCDATE(),

    CONSTRAINT PK_Dispute PRIMARY KEY (Id),
    CONSTRAINT FK_Dispute_Contract FOREIGN KEY (ContractId) REFERENCES Contract(Id),
    CONSTRAINT FK_Dispute_RaisedBy FOREIGN KEY (RaisedByUserId) REFERENCES AspNetUsers(Id),
    CONSTRAINT FK_Dispute_Moderator FOREIGN KEY (AssignedModeratorUserId) REFERENCES AspNetUsers(Id),
    CONSTRAINT CK_Dispute_Status CHECK (Status IN (0, 1, 2, 3)),
    -- 0=Open, 1=UnderReview, 2=Resolved, 3=Closed
    CONSTRAINT CK_Dispute_Priority CHECK (Priority IN (0, 1, 2, 3))
    -- 0=Low, 1=Medium, 2=High, 3=Critical
);

-- =============================================
-- DISPUTE ATTACHMENTS
-- =============================================
CREATE TABLE DisputeAttachment (
    Id              UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL DEFAULT NEWSEQUENTIALID(),
    DisputeId       UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL,
    StoredFileId    UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL,
    CreatedAt       DATETIME2        NOT NULL DEFAULT GETUTCDATE(),

    CONSTRAINT PK_DisputeAttachment PRIMARY KEY (Id),
    CONSTRAINT FK_DispAttach_Dispute FOREIGN KEY (DisputeId) REFERENCES Dispute(Id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    CONSTRAINT FK_DispAttach_File FOREIGN KEY (StoredFileId) REFERENCES StoredFile(Id)
);

-- =============================================
-- NOTIFICATIONS
-- =============================================
CREATE TABLE Notification (
    Id                  UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL DEFAULT NEWSEQUENTIALID(),
    Title               NVARCHAR(200)    NOT NULL,
    Message             NVARCHAR(MAX)    NOT NULL,
    NotificationType    INT              NOT NULL,
    RelatedEntityType   VARCHAR(50)      NULL,     -- 'LegalCase', 'Contract', 'Proposal', etc.
    RelatedEntityId     UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NULL,     -- FK to the related entity
    CreatedAt           DATETIME2        NOT NULL DEFAULT GETUTCDATE(),

    CONSTRAINT PK_Notification PRIMARY KEY (Id),
    CONSTRAINT CK_Notification_Type CHECK (NotificationType >= 0 AND NotificationType <= 18)
);

-- =============================================
-- USER NOTIFICATIONS
-- =============================================
CREATE TABLE UserNotification (
    Id              UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL DEFAULT NEWSEQUENTIALID(),
    NotificationId  UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL,
    UserId          UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL,
    IsRead          BIT              NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    ReadAt          DATETIME2        NULL,
    CreatedAt       DATETIME2        NOT NULL DEFAULT GETUTCDATE(),

    CONSTRAINT PK_UserNotification PRIMARY KEY (Id),
    CONSTRAINT FK_UserNotif_Notification FOREIGN KEY (NotificationId) REFERENCES Notification(Id),
    CONSTRAINT FK_UserNotif_User FOREIGN KEY (UserId) REFERENCES AspNetUsers(Id)
);

CREATE INDEX IX_UserNotif_UserReadCreated ON UserNotification(UserId, IsRead, CreatedAt DESC);

-- =============================================
-- NOTIFICATION PREFERENCES
-- =============================================
CREATE TABLE NotificationPreference (
    UserId          UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL,
    EnableInApp     BIT              NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
    EnableEmail     BIT              NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
    EnableSms       BIT              NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    CreatedAt       DATETIME2        NOT NULL DEFAULT GETUTCDATE(),
    UpdatedAt       DATETIME2        NOT NULL DEFAULT GETUTCDATE(),

    CONSTRAINT PK_NotificationPreference PRIMARY KEY (UserId),
    CONSTRAINT FK_NotifPref_User FOREIGN KEY (UserId) REFERENCES AspNetUsers(Id)
);
```

## Module 6 — AI Assistant

```sql
-- =============================================
-- AI CONVERSATIONS
-- =============================================
CREATE TABLE AIConversation (
    Id                      UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL DEFAULT NEWSEQUENTIALID(),
    UserId                  UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL,
    RelatedLegalCaseId      UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NULL,
    Title                   NVARCHAR(200)    NOT NULL,
    ConversationType        INT              NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    CreatedAt               DATETIME2        NOT NULL DEFAULT GETUTCDATE(),
    UpdatedAt               DATETIME2        NOT NULL DEFAULT GETUTCDATE(),

    CONSTRAINT PK_AIConversation PRIMARY KEY (Id),
    CONSTRAINT FK_AIConv_User FOREIGN KEY (UserId) REFERENCES AspNetUsers(Id),
    CONSTRAINT FK_AIConv_Case FOREIGN KEY (RelatedLegalCaseId) REFERENCES LegalCase(Id),
    CONSTRAINT CK_AIConv_Type CHECK (ConversationType IN (0, 1))
    -- 0=GeneralLegal, 1=LawyerResearch
);

-- =============================================
-- AI MESSAGES
-- =============================================
CREATE TABLE AIMessage (
    Id                  UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL DEFAULT NEWSEQUENTIALID(),
    ConversationId      UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL,
    SenderType          INT              NOT NULL,
    Content             NVARCHAR(MAX)    NOT NULL,
    ModelName           VARCHAR(100)     NULL,     -- Nullable for user messages
    PromptTokens        INT              NULL,     -- Nullable for user messages
    CompletionTokens    INT              NULL,     -- Nullable for user messages
    TotalTokens         INT              NULL,     -- Nullable for user messages
    ResponseTimeMs      INT              NULL,     -- Nullable for user messages
    CreatedAt           DATETIME2        NOT NULL DEFAULT GETUTCDATE(),

    CONSTRAINT PK_AIMessage PRIMARY KEY (Id),
    CONSTRAINT FK_AIMsg_Conversation FOREIGN KEY (ConversationId) REFERENCES AIConversation(Id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    CONSTRAINT CK_AIMsg_SenderType CHECK (SenderType IN (0, 1))
    -- 0=User, 1=AI
);

CREATE INDEX IX_AIMessage_ConversationCreatedAt ON AIMessage(ConversationId, CreatedAt);
```

## Module 7 — Knowledge Base

```sql
-- =============================================
-- LEGAL ARTICLES
-- =============================================
CREATE TABLE LegalArticle (
    Id                      UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL DEFAULT NEWSEQUENTIALID(),
    AuthorLawyerUserId      UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL,
    Title                   NVARCHAR(200)    NOT NULL,
    Summary                 NVARCHAR(MAX)    NOT NULL,
    Content                 NVARCHAR(MAX)    NOT NULL,
    Status                  INT              NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    Slug                    VARCHAR(250)     NULL,
    PublishedAt             DATETIME2        NULL,
    ViewCount               INT              NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    CreatedAt               DATETIME2        NOT NULL DEFAULT GETUTCDATE(),
    UpdatedAt               DATETIME2        NOT NULL DEFAULT GETUTCDATE(),

    CONSTRAINT PK_LegalArticle PRIMARY KEY (Id),
    CONSTRAINT FK_LegalArticle_Author FOREIGN KEY (AuthorLawyerUserId) REFERENCES LawyerProfile(UserId),
    CONSTRAINT CK_LegalArticle_Status CHECK (Status IN (0, 1, 2, 3)),
    -- 0=Draft, 1=PendingApproval, 2=Published, 3=Rejected
    CONSTRAINT CK_LegalArticle_ViewCount CHECK (ViewCount >= 0)
);

CREATE INDEX IX_LegalArticle_StatusPublished ON LegalArticle(Status, PublishedAt DESC);

-- =============================================
-- ARTICLE CATEGORIES (Junction Table)
-- =============================================
CREATE TABLE LegalArticleCategory (
    LegalArticleId  UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL,
    LegalCategoryId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL,

    CONSTRAINT PK_LegalArticleCategory PRIMARY KEY (LegalArticleId, LegalCategoryId),
    CONSTRAINT FK_ArtCat_Article FOREIGN KEY (LegalArticleId) REFERENCES LegalArticle(Id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    CONSTRAINT FK_ArtCat_Category FOREIGN KEY (LegalCategoryId) REFERENCES LegalCategory(Id) ON DELETE CASCADE
);

-- =============================================
-- ARTICLE ATTACHMENTS
-- =============================================
CREATE TABLE LegalArticleAttachment (
    Id              UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL DEFAULT NEWSEQUENTIALID(),
    LegalArticleId  UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL,
    StoredFileId    UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL,
    CreatedAt       DATETIME2        NOT NULL DEFAULT GETUTCDATE(),

    CONSTRAINT PK_LegalArticleAttachment PRIMARY KEY (Id),
    CONSTRAINT FK_ArtAttach_Article FOREIGN KEY (LegalArticleId) REFERENCES LegalArticle(Id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    CONSTRAINT FK_ArtAttach_File FOREIGN KEY (StoredFileId) REFERENCES StoredFile(Id)
);
```

## Cross-Cutting — Audit Trail (NEW)

```sql
-- =============================================
-- STATUS CHANGE LOG (Audit Trail for all entities)
-- =============================================
CREATE TABLE StatusChangeLog (
    Id                  UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL DEFAULT NEWSEQUENTIALID(),
    EntityType          VARCHAR(50)      NOT NULL,  -- 'LegalCase', 'Contract', 'Dispute', etc.
    EntityId            UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL,
    OldStatus           INT              NOT NULL,
    NewStatus           INT              NOT NULL,
    ChangedByUserId     UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NULL,      -- NULL for system-triggered changes
    Reason              NVARCHAR(MAX)    NULL,
    CreatedAt           DATETIME2        NOT NULL DEFAULT GETUTCDATE(),

    CONSTRAINT PK_StatusChangeLog PRIMARY KEY (Id),
    CONSTRAINT FK_StatusLog_User FOREIGN KEY (ChangedByUserId) REFERENCES AspNetUsers(Id)
);

CREATE INDEX IX_StatusChangeLog_EntityTypeId ON StatusChangeLog(EntityType, EntityId);
CREATE INDEX IX_StatusChangeLog_CreatedAt ON StatusChangeLog(CreatedAt);
```
